newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms pass on 21,500T of wheat tender.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms pass on 21,500T of wheat tender.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd said on Friday they passed on tenders for 21,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat due to high offer prices.

Of the total, Cheiljedang invited tenders for 12,000 tonnes at basis prices over July futures on the U.S grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade, a Cheiljedang official said. Earlier Friday, traders said Cheiljedang had invited the tender at basis over May futures.
Dongah Flour invited the remaining 9,500 tonnes at flat prices. Shipment was set for May 5-June 5 to the western port of Inchon.
Traders said the lowest bids were made from Japanese trading house Kanematsu Corp.
